title: ജനം ജയിപ്പിച്ച സർക്കാരിനെ ഡൽഹി പുറത്താക്കി 🗳️❌ ഇല്ലായിരുന്നെങ്കിലോ? #shorts
description:
1957-ൽ കേരളം ബാലറ്റ് പെട്ടിയിലൂടെ ഒരു കമ്മ്യൂണിസ്റ്റ് സർക്കാരിനെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തു. 1959 ജൂലൈ 31-ന് ഡൽഹി ആ സർക്കാരിനെ പിരിച്ചുവിട്ടു. അന്ന് പിരിച്ചുവിട്ടില്ലായിരുന്നെങ്കിലോ?

In the first Kerala Assembly election (1957) the CPI won 60 of 126 seats and formed a majority with 5 independents; E.M.S. Namboodiripad was sworn in on 5 April 1957. Within days an ordinance stayed evictions of tenants. The Kerala Education Bill (1957) and the Agrarian Relations Bill (passed June 1959) followed. In June–July 1959 the Vimochana Samaram, led by Mannathu Padmanabhan of the NSS with the Catholic Church, the Muslim League and Congress, filled the streets; police firings at Angamaly, Pulluvila and elsewhere killed protesters. On 31 July 1959, with the ministry still holding its Assembly majority, the Union government under Nehru imposed President's Rule under Article 356. In the 1960 election the CPI's vote share rose (about 35% to 39%) but its seats fell from 60 to 29 against a united opposition. President's Rule has since been imposed well over 100 times.

Characters are friendly cartoon caricatures. The cricket comparison is our own joke, and the 'what if' (including land reform maybe a decade earlier) is our own thought experiment.

Sources: Wikipedia (First Namboodiripad ministry, Vimochana Samaram, 1960 Kerala Legislative Assembly election, President's rule, Land reforms in Kerala).
